conclusion: The large PA-open broadband/static floor is a CSR-off Linux family symptom, not a v8-unique regression. CPS-v3 CSR-on is acoustically quiet and essentially identical to Windows. Windows is also CSR-off yet quiet under a proven continuously non-zero active stream, so an additional Windows WSA8845 initialization/state dependency is missing on Linux. v8 does not improve the symptom and is ~17% worse than v5 in median diff-RMS, so it remains non-promotable, but the earlier categorical v8-only zero-noise rejection is superseded.
